origin: cwe/787/c Key Principles: validate offset <= buf_len first, then length <= buf_len - offset

finding.name: Out-of-bounds Write
finding.summary: The helper checks only length against capacity, then writes at destination + offset without proving offset + length fits in the destination.

trap: Changing the check to offset + length > capacity without considering unsigned overflow, or checking length against the input payload size only. The fix must validate offset first and then length <= capacity - offset before memcpy().
must_preserve: Valid payload writes at a nonzero offset still work, oversized writes are rejected without modifying memory beyond the frame, and the helper keeps receiving capacity explicitly from its caller.
